message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large, grey, block letters. The background is a dark, desaturated brown. At the bottom right, two men in orange jumpsuits stand with their hands behind their backs, facing away. Strings extend upward from their heads and shoulders. These strings are held by a wooden crossbar in the hand of a larger, shadowy figure dressed in a dark police uniform with a peaked cap. This figure, in turn, has strings extending from its head and shoulders to another wooden crossbar held by a much larger, even more shadowy figure whose torso and hand dominate the left side of the frame. 

Text includes "EMPAT PENERUS GUS DUR" and "LOBI DI BALIK LOBSTER" at the top. The phrase "ASIK DIBACA DAN PERLU" appears in small letters beneath the masthead. Large white text on the right reads "MASIH GELAP" followed by "SEDERET KEJANGGALAN MEWARNAI PENANGKAPAN DUA POLISI PENYERANG NOVEL BASWEDAN. DALANGNYA BELUM TERUNGKAP." At the bottom left, white text lists dates "6-12 JANUARI 2020", price "RP 45.000", and a website. A barcode is at the very bottom.
